about: Page comments (M70.2): a page's threads live in <vault>/.comments/<page path>.json, never in the page. Rust (vault/comments.rs) and TS (engine/comments.ts, the mock) replay every section: the limits; the path mapping (a sidecar maps back to a page only for a .md with no hidden name); parse (text to file, or the reason it can't be read); ops (a file before, or null for none, an op and its context, to the file after, 'unchanged', or the refusal's exact words); and bytes (a file to the exact text written: key order, omitted keys, two-space indent, raw non-ASCII and a final newline). Characters are counted as code points.
